name: RowList
summary: Rows of named facts, one hairline above each and no enclosure, in proportional columns that stack below the small breakpoint: a reference list read from top to bottom (token rows, scales, specimens beside their values). Not for comparing values across columns with a header row (use DataTable) or across contexts (use ContextMatrix).
a11y: A native `ul`, or `ol` when the order means something; each row is one list item, so the count and position are announced. Name what a row shows in its own cells: a decorative specimen is `aria-hidden`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Each column's width; the row's cells fill them in order.

props.name: ordered
props.description: Number the rows (`ol`) when their order means something, such as a scale from small to large.

props.name: specimen
props.description: `large` gives rows with a large live specimen (text at its real size) more room between rows and columns.

props.name: align
props.description: How the cells line up in a row: on the first line of text, centred on the specimen, or filling the row's height from the top.

props.name: cells
props.description: One cell per column, in order.

props.name: data
props.description: `data-*` attributes for the row, for tooling such as revision anchors.
